summary: Concept-stage risk register for a reversible, rights-preserving 100-day pilot. Scores indicate attention level, not approval status.

dimensions.label: 数据隐私 / Data privacy
dimensions.note: Public interfaces may expose or over-collect personal or sensitive data.
dimensions.mitigation: Minimum-data contracts, anonymous route, withdrawal register and no diagnosis or behavioural profile in public interfaces.
dimensions.human_review: Data and rights reviewer signs G1 and every withdrawal or incident receipt.

dimensions.label: 实施复杂度 / Implementation complexity
dimensions.note: Heritage, rail, fire, flood, utility and ownership interfaces remain authority-dependent.
dimensions.mitigation: G0 evidence lock, 3 m reversible mock-up and explicit stop conditions before any site release.
dimensions.human_review: Relevant planning, heritage, safety and utility professionals decide the applicable constraints.

dimensions.label: 公众接受 / Public acceptance
dimensions.note: AI interfaces can exclude no-device users or be mistaken for mandatory public service.
dimensions.mitigation: Paper, staffed and ordinary routes remain visible; twelve acceptance scenarios include refusal and complaint recovery.
dimensions.human_review: Resident and accessibility panels review G2 evidence; operator records dissent and response.

dimensions.label: 运营成本 / Operations cost
dimensions.note: Staffing, maintenance, moderation and complaint handling can outlive prototype budgets.
dimensions.mitigation: No L3 release without a named operator, resource band and operating budget; otherwise remain L1/L2 or exit.
dimensions.human_review: Programme sponsor and operator confirm lifecycle responsibility before continuation.

dimensions.label: 政策不确定性 / Policy uncertainty
dimensions.note: The proposal is a public co-creation concept and does not confer planning or procurement authority.
dimensions.mitigation: Visible conceptual labels, decision receipts and separate states for submitted, reviewed, selected, deepened and implemented.
dimensions.human_review: Authorised agencies make every statutory, land, procurement and implementation decision.

dimensions.label: 空间争议 / Spatial dispute
dimensions.note: Open map orientation and conceptual geometry could be mistaken for official redlines or parcel conclusions.
dimensions.mitigation: OSM is orientation-only; replace, clip and recalculate all layers when official geometry is released.
dimensions.human_review: Planning authority validates boundary, ownership and interface geometry at G0.

dimensions.label: 技术成熟度 / Technology maturity
dimensions.note: AI service may fail, hallucinate or become unavailable during ordinary use.
dimensions.mitigation: Power-off, network-loss, misinformation and staff-absence tests; human takeover and ordinary recovery are blockers.
dimensions.human_review: Sector professional owns content and stop decisions; technical reviewer signs failure evidence.

dimensions.label: 公平包容 / Equity and inclusion
dimensions.note: Older people, children, disabled people and non-smartphone users may bear disproportionate failure costs.
dimensions.mitigation: Continuous 1.8 m design target, no-device route, accessibility replay and disaggregated complaint evidence.
dimensions.human_review: Accessibility and representative user panels verify the ordinary route before G2.

risks.risk: provisional geometry mistaken for official redline
risks.control: visible provisional labels; no parcel conclusion
risks.response: replace, clip and recalculate every layer and figure

risks.risk: AI service displaces ordinary public service
risks.control: ordinary route and staffed window are G2 blockers
minimum data, anonymous route, withdrawal register
risks.response: freeze processing, notify, delete temporary state, investigate

risks.risk: accessibility blocked during setup or failure
risks.control: continuous 1.8 m design target and accessibility replay
risks.response: remove prototype and restore ordinary route

risks.risk: health, education or commerce output causes harm
risks.control: qualified professional owner and sector hard tests
risks.response: stop, disclose incident, provide human service, review

risks.risk: maintenance and complaint costs are unfunded
risks.control: no L3 release without operating budget and named owner

risks.risk: heritage, fire, flood, rail or utilities conflict
risks.control: G0 evidence lock and specialist review

risks.risk: contribution wall implies award or government endorsement
planning allowances, proposed owners or approval steps are mistaken for confirmed budgets, procurement or assigned government action
risks.control: label every cost band as a planning allowance, every owner as pending authorisation and every permit as unconfirmed; require G0 written authority before procurement or site release
risks.trigger: a public brief omits conceptual status or presents an allowance as an approved commitment
risks.response: correct the public record, suspend procurement or pilot activity and return the item to G0

risks.risk: conceptual visualisations are mistaken for existing conditions, official planning material or an approved built outcome
risks.control: persistent bilingual conceptual labels, a method and rights note, no official marks and no use of rendered scenes as quantitative evidence
risks.trigger: a scene is reproduced without its conceptual label or cited as site evidence
risks.response: withdraw or relabel the image and redirect the claim to the source-backed technical figure
